column1: # Convention spot-checks run by .claude/hooks/convention-spot-check.sh on Stop.
# One check per line, three TAB-separated fields:
# A file changed this session whose path matches field 1 and whose content matches
# field 2 is reported once. Keep checks to cheap, low-false-positive structural
# smells; judgement calls belong in docs/conventions/ and the convention-checker agent.
# Named exports are not checked here: Biome enforces noDefaultExport.
